title: Chapter 144
text:
Being on the battlefield now was not the best time to advance. Of course, he had to leave the battlefield first.

He first dealt with the other information, such as [Battle of the Tedramira River]. The final evaluation was B. He received 450,000 EXP, which was more than he expected. The EXP accumulated on the interface was in the millions.

[Dust of the Fallen Seeds]'s A-level mission progress increased by 2%, and the reward of active sabotage was even better. The Germinal Organization's evacuation force was a mix of various bases. Since Stardragon and Hesla had destroyed them, he could also get a share of the loot.

The total progress was 21%, which was the requirement to complete the mission successfully. There was no more progress to be gained in the Southern Continent. The interception war in the Western Continent and the Northern Continent would also take place today, so the progress would probably increase a little. After that, if he wanted to increase the progress, he could only go to the Germinal Organization's base camp, Andrea.

There was still progress to be gained in the future, so naturally, Han Xiao would not end [Dust of the Fallen Seeds] immediately. The minimum requirement was 20%, and he had already completed it. This gave him confidence. Since he could complete the mission at any time, he was not in a hurry to complete the mission. He would try to get a higher evaluation.

According to his experience, the higher the evaluation of the A-level mission, the more special the final reward would be. Not only EXP, but also skills, talents, potential points, special items, and even attribute points were not impossible.

Driving the truck, Han Xiao arrived at the location where the Dark Net's helicopter was parked. The pilot was already on standby. He packed up the useful machinery in the truck and threw it onto the helicopter. Then, he blew up the truck, leaving no trace.

The truck cost him a lot of money, but he had plenty of money in his account, so he did not care about the cost of the truck. As the saying went, it was easy to go from frugal to extravagant, but difficult to go from extravagant to frugal. Han Xiao was glad that he knew how to make money. The market potential of the players was huge, so he did not need to worry about money in the short term. He did not want to experience the days when he was a mechanic again.

"They say that men become bad when they have money. It's true." Han Xiao sighed. He took a few puffs of his cigarette, sat on the helicopter, and ordered the pilot to take off.

The rotors blew a strong wind, and the land in his sight gradually shrank. Han Xiao retracted his gaze and closed his eyes to rest.

…

The dark sea waves rolled, and the sea breeze carried the smell of blood.

After escaping the pursuit, the Germinal Organization's fleet sailed on the boundless sea. The main ship turned on the anti-detection device to prevent being discovered by satellites.

There were many ownerless orbiting satellites in Blue Star's outer space. They were all left behind by the fallen countries of the old era. Some of these satellites were taken over by the Six Nations, some fell into the hands of other forces, some became public satellites for hackers, and some became space junk.

Every ship had scorch marks from the explosion. The maintenance workers were busy repairing them, nailing steel plates to the gaps and repairing the damaged mechanical components. The idle armed personnel were cleaning the deck and washing away the bloodstains.

They had suffered heavy losses trying to break through the blockade. Just the Executive Officers alone had lost seventeen of them, and Han Xiao had killed three of them by himself. Lin Yu reported the details of the battle to the leader and emphasized this matter.

Black Phantom's interference made the leader very surprised. At the same time, he was very angry. This made him feel like the Germinal Organization had become a toothless tiger that could be bullied by anyone. Because of this, he hated Zero even more.

He disrupted the organization's plans and even dragged the organization into a dangerous situation. The leader would occasionally think of the conversation when Zero had escaped from the laboratory. That traitor had kept his promise. Every time he thought of it, it made him even angrier.

However, the leader only added Black Phantom to the observation list. He did not have the energy to pay attention to a small assassin. The next step of the organization was the leader's biggest problem.

All the bases in the three continents had been evacuated. They had lost the initiative, and the Six Nations had no more worries. It was very likely that they would seize this opportunity to start a war and attack Andrea first. This was not what the leader wanted to see. The organization's strength was greatly damaged, and he urgently needed time to recover. Furthermore, Zero, who had the ability to predict the future, had to be eliminated.

The Germinal Organization had been operating in Andrea for a long time. If the Six Nations wanted to attack, they had no other choice but to land and fight.

Launch an intercontinental nuclear bomb? Not to mention that there were still civilians living in Andrea, the Germinal Organization also had land-based anti-missile facilities. If they were forced into a corner, they could activate the Hand of Death system and destroy the world. Of course, this was the last resort and could not be used as a trump card. Even if it was used as a threat, the Six Nations would not let the Germinal Organization continue to develop.

Perhaps Red Maple, Ordina, and Hesla would compromise and scheme behind the scenes. However, the reckless Theseus and the crazy Raylan would definitely not care about any form of compromise. They would only launch an even fiercer counterattack. You want to die together? Go ahead and try. If you frown, you lose.

In the original storyline, the four continents were the battlefields of the Germinal Organization of the Six Nations. Those secret bases restricted the Six Nations and had a huge impact on the war situation. It was like the difference between holding a straight and a bomb in one's hand when playing Dou Dizhu.

At the climax of the war, the Germinal Organization was defeated and almost destroyed. That was when the Hand of Death system was exposed. As there were not many armed forces left, some of the politicians of the Six Nations chose to compromise. In the eyes of some people, the goal of defeating the Germinal Organization had been achieved. There was no need to fight head-on anymore. Furthermore, the Six Nations had also suffered losses, so they decided to focus on containment and let the remaining Germinal Organization stay in Andrea. After all, it was an abandoned land that no one wanted. Although they could not eliminate the root of the problem, they could prevent the Germinal Organization from rising again.

The current situation was that the nail that restricted the Six Nations had been removed. The Germinal Organization had lost its powerful means of threatening the Six Nations, such as massacring civilians and destroying cities. Only the base camp in Andrea was left. The Six Nations could combine their forces and go on expeditions to their heart's content. This put the Germinal Organization in a very bad situation.

The most important thing now was to divert the attention of the Six Nations and not give them the time and resources to start a war. The leader thought about it again and again but could not come up with a good idea.

"Leader, Base 013 has an emergency report. It's about a recently successful test subject of the [Genetic Improvement Program]. This is the observation record." An assistant handed over a report.

The leader had a headache whenever he heard the word 'test subject'. He took the report and glanced at it. Suddenly, he paused.

Seeing this, the assistant added, "Cases like this have appeared on more than one person. The following is the list. According to the investigation of the intelligence personnel, this phenomenon seems to be happening on a large scale and spreading like a contagious disease."

The leader was silent for a long time as if he was digesting the information. Suddenly, a cold laugh came out from under the mask.

"Strange phenomenon. Maybe luck is on our side. The Six Nations are going to be busy."

…

In the room on the ship, the light bulb was dim and flickering unsteadily. Hella took off her black combat suit and counted the wounds on her body in front of the mirror. The most obvious one was a scabbed bullet hole on the side of her ribs. The black blood stain was shocking.

Hella was expressionless. She rubbed the wound a few times with her fingers. The scab fell off, revealing new tender flesh.

She looked at her body in the mirror. Her skin was smooth and white without any old scars. Only she remembered how many times she had been injured.

Hella lowered her eyes. Her long eyelashes covered her eyes. She put on her clothes again and looked at the dark sea outside the porthole silently.

Live and wait for the next battle.

…

Zhang Wei's team returned on Division 13's private plane. Other than Zhang Wei, who was writing the report, the rest of the team closed their eyes to rest.

"Say … how did Han Xiao become Black Phantom?" Li Yalin suddenly opened her eyes. She was confused.

"What? Brother Xiao is Black Phantom?" Lin Yao was shocked. He did not participate in the battle, so he did not know about this.

Zhang Wei told them what had happened.

Lin Yao was stunned. After a while, he could not help but ask, "Are you sure?"

"I can recognize him even if he turns into ashes!" Li Yalin sneered. As a creditor, she was that confident.

"Aren't we going to get him back?"

"His departure was very strange. He must have taken on a secret mission. When I submit the report later, I will ask the higher-ups." Zhang Wei shook his head.

Li Yalin could not help but say, "Help me ask when he plans to return the money …"

Zhang Wei was speechless.

"Little Lin Lin, you don't look injured." Di Su Su, who was on the same plane, walked over. Li Yalin's face fell. She snorted arrogantly and turned her head away, ignoring her.

Di Su Su did not stand on ceremony. She squeezed past the shy Lin Yao and sat down next to Li Ya Lin with a teasing smile on her face. Li Ya Lin hurriedly moved away as if Di Su Su was the source of the virus.
